## What's new in QOTA 16.10.0

- Desk opens in Collection. The dock gives direct access to Collection, Billing, Governance, and Expenditures.
- Payment Receipts calculate outstanding debt on the server before and after applying the payment. Debt Refinancing records each settled debt, and the customer statement shows the refinancing as a credit.
- Service Fine records a charge in the debt ledger. A suspension for an unpaid fine uses a separate Service Suspension order linked to a submitted fine for the same contract.
- Water Issue Report adds administrative review for water issue reports. Moving a report to `Seen` records who reviewed it and when.
- Institutional Settings manages weekly office hours, holidays, exceptional hours, closures, and office locations.
- Subscriber captures a national phone number and region, validates the number, and derives its E.164 format. Existing numbers are preserved and still require region assignment.
- Suspension orders distinguish scheduling from execution and record the date of the physical cut. The reconnection fee is waived when the last executed suspension was requested by the subscriber.
- Monthly fee advances apply to charges for the same billing period. The migration releases historical allocations to other charge types and reapplies the advance when a matching monthly charge exists.
- QOTA removes obsolete readers and its legacy messaging integration. The independent messaging platform owns conversations and automation.

This release includes schema changes and data patches. Run the Frappe site migration as part of installation or upgrade. The historical Monthly Bill discrepancies are scheduled for a separate update.
